intro: 我主导研发基于 JAX/XLA 的固定翼仿真平台，把非线性六自由度动力学、气动查表、环境反馈和强化学习放进 GPU 并行闭环，让大规模训练建立在飞行物理上。

I led development of a JAX/XLA fixed-wing simulation platform that combines nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom dynamics, aerodynamic lookup tables, environment feedback, and RL in a batched GPU loop, bringing flight physics to large-scale learning.
bullets: Tensor-LUT 在 GPU 上批量查询和插值气动系数；统一接口覆盖单机跟踪、编队协作与集群交互，并部署 PPO、MAPPO 和分层强化学习。

Tensor-LUT evaluates aerodynamic coefficients through batched GPU lookup and interpolation. A shared interface supports single-aircraft tracking, formation, and swarm interaction with PPO, MAPPO, and hierarchical RL.
完成 50v50 集群自博弈训练；下方提供 100 架飞机同时交互的已有仿真回放，直观展示平台承载的场景规模。
Completed 50-vs-50 swarm self-play training. The existing replay below shows 100 aircraft interacting, illustrating the scale of the supported scenarios.
在 A100 80GB、100 万并行样本的 10 步动力学 rollout 测试中，实测约 3070 万条短轨迹/秒；同模型下为 PyTorch eager 的 13.5 倍、torch.compile 的 1.73 倍。

For 10-step dynamics rollouts with one million parallel samples on an A100 80GB, measured throughput was about 30.7 million short rollouts/s: 13.5× PyTorch eager and 1.73× torch.compile with the same physics model.
